confidence_notes: Krabi's reported restaurant basket supports the meal, coffee and beer estimates, though the local sample appears limited. Hostel anchors use aggregated nightly averages; the private-room figure is for the room. Cocktail and wine estimates are less certain and reflect typical tourist-bar prices relative to local draft beer. Hotel anchors are holistic estimates; no current hotel listings were inspected.
comparable_city_reasoning: Direct Krabi price observations were available for restaurant meals, coffee and domestic draft beer; no comparable city was needed.
